manual_link_experiment.purpose: Check whether the resolve-enabled Vulkan provider objects and P2 plugin can link against the existing Android runtime DSO without rebuilding Process 1 runtime sources.
manual_link_experiment.standard_cmake_target: The CMake build successfully produced rexui-vulkan and the P2 renderer library, then stopped building rexruntime at the Bionic getcontext/makecontext/swapcontext and rex::GetAndroidApiLevel errors recorded in process2_android_resolve_plugin_build_20261025.json.
manual_link_experiment.link_method: Reused the generated CMake link scripts for the plugin and provider capability test, replacing only the missing SDK librexruntime.so input with the unchanged extracted librexruntimed.so. The plugin translation unit was compiled with SHIFT_REXGLUE_OPTIONAL_DEPTH_STENCIL_RESOLVE_PROVIDER=1 and the resulting DSO contains VulkanProvider::Create(bool, bool, bool, bool). Linker --no-undefined checks succeeded.
